migration_page_description: Startup migrations and their prerequisites run first. Regular tasks then run in order, while independent tasks share a cluster-wide limit of 3 concurrent tasks.

migrations.20261009_backfill_agent_sandb: Backfills teamId for legacy agent sandbox instances from their App/Skill source. Orphan records whose source was deleted are skipped and counted; records whose source exists without a teamId are reported as failed records for repair and retry.
Scanned {{scannedCount}} sandbox instances, backfilled {{backfilledCount}} team bindings, skipped {{orphanCount}} orphan records.
skipped_configs: The following legacy config items were not migrated or need manual action: {{paths}}
failure_blocks_startup: A startup migration failed. Check the logs, fix the issue, and restart the lease-owning App node.
migrations.20261022_backfill_folder_ance: Rebuild App, tool, and Dataset folder ancestorIds paths from parentId, and remove stale values from non-folders. Records whose parent folder type does not match (app folders vs tool folders) are moved to the root instead of failing the migration; other records that cannot be migrated safely are listed for repair and retry.
Scanned {{scannedCount}} resource records; {{failedCount}} unresolved records remain.
Backfill App and tool folder paths
migrations.20261025_token_prices_per_mil: Migrate system model prices to million units

Reads system models once and saves pricing in one batch. Token/TTS rates are multiplied by 1000; STT rates are copied unchanged. Preserves root-level prices and skips valid existing pricing. Team models are free. Runs in the background; fix invalid data and retry after a failure.
Migrated {{migratedCount}} system models to pricing. Original prices and team models remain unchanged.
migrations.20261022_initialize_dataset_v: First verify and remove the legacy global HNSW index online. Once removal succeeds, count existing Dataset vectors in the background and schedule FP16 partial indexes for Datasets with more than 10,000 vectors. Index jobs run without a delay, one at a time globally. Migration completion does not mean all partial indexes are ready. Exact search remains available while indexes are being built.
Counted {{scannedCount}} datasets; {{eligibleCount}} met the index threshold. Index builds continue in the queue.
Count dataset vectors and schedule index builds
Remove the legacy global HNSW index
migrations.20261104_backfill_chat_publis: Backfill historical call sources in an independent background task after startup, preserving all legacy fields.
migrations.20261104_backfill_openapi_key: Independently scan all API keys in background batches, fill missing types as personal, and normalize valid app IDs to BSON ObjectId values while preserving default targets, credentials, and permissions.
migrations.20261116_migrate_system_confi: Migrate legacy settings and environment variables, remove deprecated fields, and backfill managed settings before starting business services.
Migrated {{migratedDomainCount}} configuration domains and removed {{removedFieldCount}} deprecated fields; {{skippedConfigCount}} legacy settings were skipped or require attention.
migrations.20261120_migrate_model_pricin: After startup, backfills duration-based STT pricing types and system LLM tier limits in thousands of tokens in the background. Keeps legacy limits for rollback.
Scanned {{sttModels}} STT models and backfilled tier limits in thousands of tokens for {{llmModels}} system LLM models.
migrations.20261123_cleanup_mongo_indexe: Runs independently in the background after startup to remove retired MongoDB indexes: continuously waits for required replacement indexes to finish building before dropping, matches exact index name, key, and options, and preserves customer-managed or mismatched indexes. When MONGO_DEPRECATE_INDEX=false, existing deprecated indexes are kept and deferred for retry after enabling the flag or manual removal.
Checked {{totalCount}} deprecated indexes: dropped {{droppedCount}}, already absent {{missingCount}}, safely skipped {{skippedCount}}.
migrations.20261117_migrate_sandbox_to_o: Run manually after all legacy app pods are offline. Read-only migrates running Sealos Devboxes, stopped Devboxes, legacy OpenSandbox /workspace volumes, and legacy S3 package.zip archives from agent_sandbox_instances_v2 into agent_sandbox_instances_v3 and sandbox/archive-v2/ (.tar.zst), leaving legacy records, Devboxes, volumes, and package.zip intact for rollback.
Migrated {{runningDevbox}} running Devboxes, {{stoppedDevbox}} stopped Devboxes, and {{legacyArchives}} legacy archives and volumes
migrations.20261117_cleanup_legacy_sandb: Run manually after verifying the OpenSandbox migration in production. Enforces zero unmigrated active records in agent_sandbox_instances_v2, then deletes remote legacy Sealos Devboxes, legacy persistent volumes, and verified legacy package.zip objects while keeping agent_sandbox_instances_v2 read-only.
Cleaned up {{deletedDevboxes}} remote Devboxes, {{deletedVolumes}} legacy volumes, and {{deletedZips}} legacy zip objects
